description: There is an unbounded family of size b, every unbounded family has size at least b, and every family of size less than b is eventually bounded.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BoundingAndDominating.boundingNumber_spec :
  (∃ B,
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BoundingAndDominating.IsUnbounded B ∧
        Cardinal.mk ↑B = Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BoundingAndDominating.boundingNumber) ∧
    (∀ (B : Set (ℕ → ℕ)),
        Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BoundingAndDominating.IsUnbounded B →
          Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BoundingAndDominating.boundingNumber ≤ Cardinal.mk ↑B) ∧
      ∀ (B : Set (ℕ → ℕ)),
        Cardinal.mk ↑B < Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BoundingAndDominating.boundingNumber →
          Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BoundingAndDominating.IsBounded B
